notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (requests + Chrome UA) succeeded fully - robots.txt allows User-agent:* Allow:/ (no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai block), homepage and all collection pages returned 200 with full server-rendered mega-menu and page content; no Playwright/Chrome escalation needed. TREE: built from union of (1) server-rendered mega-menu inside <header id=site-header> on homepage HTML (Wallpaper / Fabric / Home Decor / Paint / Furniture columns), and (2) sitemap_collections_1.xml (154 collection URLs). Cross-checked candidate leaves against their own page h1/description. Wallpaper, Paint, Tiles, Lighting, Mirrors, and all Furniture (Chairs & Sofas, Beds & Headboards, Ottomans & Footstools, Garden Furniture) are out of scope for Textile/Storage and were excluded (neither array) per rule-file boundaries and prior-task ownership. QTY: each collection page embeds an Analyzify analytics tracking script with the Shopify collectionObj literal (title/handle/id/products_count/all_products_count) reflecting {{ collection.products_count }}; used that as the qty evidence. Cross-verified against the mobile-only <span id=ProductCount> header badge present on Bedding (9), Rugs (9) and Doormats (6) pages - all three matched the analytics count exactly, giving confidence the analytics count is the site's genuine per-collection total (not the generally-unreliable inflated storefront API). GROUPING: 'Textiles' (h1 TEXTILES, 83 products, description 'made-to-measure curtains and blinds') is a grouping parent whose count exactly equals Curtains(61)+Blinds(22)=83, so recorded as is_group with Curtains/Blinds as children per textile.md Sec25 (no parent URL when subcategories exist). 'Axminster Flooring' (41 products, wool-woven rugs/runners/carpets made by Axminster Carpets) exactly equals Carpets(14)+Rugs(9)+Runners(18)=41, so also recorded as is_group with those three as children; confidence MEDIUM on the group label itself because 'Flooring' borders the hard-flooring exclusion in textile.md Sec6, but the underlying products are woven wool soft floor coverings, not hardwood/vinyl/laminate, so the three children keep HIGH confidence. Doormats(6) is a separate standalone collection (not part of the Axminster 41 sum) and is recorded as a flat leaf. Fabric(178) is raw furnishing/upholstery fabric by the yard (site copy: 'transform our fabrics into custom curtains and blinds or bespoke upholstered furniture') with no further genuine subcategories (only colour/usage/type/style attribute-filter collections, which are cross-cutting facets, not distinct product-type nodes, and were excluded as non-nav filter collections consistent with View-All/Collection exclusion). Cushions(58) and Bedding(9) sit under the mixed 'Home Decor' menu column alongside out-of-scope Tiles/Lighting/Paint/Mirrors, so 'Home Decor' was not fabricated as a shared grouping parent (it would misrepresent scope); both recorded as flat top-level Textile leaves. EXCLUDED: all colour/usage/type/style/print attribute-filter collections (e.g. green-wallpaper, cotton-linen-fabric, floral-cushions, william-morris-wallpaper), sample/swatch collections (wallpaper-samples, fabric-samples, paint-swatches, tile-samples, sample-packs), seasonal/promo 'edit' collections (the-green-edit etc.), Wallpaper (paper, not fabric - out of scope for this task), Paint, Tiles, Lighting, Mirrors, Home Decor umbrella (mixed, not a genuine single-category node), and all Furniture collections. STORAGE: no dedicated storage/organization/basket/box/organizer/shelving/rack collection exists anywhere in the mega-menu or the full 154-URL collection sitemap - confirmed by scanning every sitemap collection handle for storage-related keywords (storage, basket, box, organiser/organizer, trunk, chest, shelf, shelving, rack, cabinet) with zero matches. storage_rows is correctly empty; this is a maximalist print/wallpaper/fabric design brand with no storage product line.
